snippet.title: Get This Satisfying Image Crusher... For $0.00! (Mossy Pixels | Official Steam Trailer)
snippet.description:
Mossy Pixels is coming to Steam on December 4th! 🥳
More Info: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

○ Our Website ► https://www.kiepska.pl/
○ Steam Games ► https://store.steampowered.com/dev/kiepska-pl

Music: @hyp3rsleep971 

Hey, welcome to Jan Kiepski: a channel about games!

Meet Mossy Pixels: a 100% free point & click game, the main purpose of which is to help you wind down, relax, and enjoy the moment. Soon you'll be able to get this satisfying image crusher... for $0.00! 

Is it going to be one of the best free games on Steam? Probably not, but I hope that it will at least make one of your evenings a little bit brighter. ^^

Whether you're an indie game developer yourself or you're interested in games made with Unity for some other reason – I'm looking forward to sharing many more entertaining videos about indie games with you! Make sure to subscribe so you don't miss them. ;)
